svg.title: Isabella Rodriguez · Emergent behavior (25 Agents · 2 days virtual time)

div.div: [09:15] Customer Klaus comes to buy coffee
[10:00] Decide to hold a Valentine's Day party
[11:30] Invite customer Maria to the party
[14:00] Ask Maria to help decorate the venue
"Who should I invite to the party?"
"How far along is the party preparation?"
→ Several invited, venue still needs decoration
"Who can help me decorate the cafe?"
12:00 Invite customers while running the shop
18:00 Hold Valentine's Day party at Hobbs
Emergent behavior (25 Agents · 2 days virtual time)
Party invite spreads to many Agents
All behaviors are not pre-programmed — emergent results of memory + reflection + social common sense reasoning
